paper.title_en: Landau-Ginzburg Theory of a Holographic Superconductor: A Horizon Perspective on the Zero-Temperature Ground State
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the effect of a quartic scalar self-interaction, $λ|ϕ|^4$, on a holographic superconductor in which non-linear electrodynamic couplings generate a superconducting dome containing an extended Lifshitz regime. The quartic interaction leaves the linearized scalar dynamics around the normal phase unchanged while modifying the non-linear solutions where the scalar field is large. As $λ$ increases, the solutions within the dome pass through three stages. The Lifshitz region shrinks until its scaling solution disappears at $λ^*$, leaving a no-AdS region, beyond whose edge the flows end before reaching any asymptotic region, and above $λ_c$ the dome consists entirely of asymptotically AdS hairy black holes. At the bottom of the dome we identify the point where the horizon value of the scalar field is largest, which we refer to as the critical point. There this value lies at the deepest symmetry-breaking minimum that the horizon effective potential, of Landau-Ginzburg form, can have. Unlike a conventional Landau-Ginzburg description, this interpretation rests on the scalar field at the horizon rather than on the boundary order parameter. Below $λ^*$, the constant scalar of the Lifshitz fixed point sits instead at the minimum of the effective potential of its asymptotic scaling region.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在全息超导体框架下研究四阶标量自相互作用对超导穹顶和 Lifshitz 区域的影响，并给出基于视界有效势的朗道-金兹堡式解释，属于全息凝聚态物理议题，理论分析与解析论证较为充分，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 全息超导体的朗道-金兹堡理论：关于零温基态的视界视角
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了四阶标量自相互作用 $\lambda|\phi|^4$ 对全息超导体的影响，其中非线性电动力学耦合产生了一个包含扩展 Lifshitz 区域的超导穹顶。四阶相互作用不改变正常相附近线性化标量动力学，但会修改标量场较大时的非线性解。随着 $\lambda$ 增大，穹顶内的解经历三个阶段。Lifshitz 区域收缩，直到其标度解在 $\lambda^*$ 处消失，留下一个非 AdS 区域，在该区域边缘之外，流动在到达任何渐近区域之前就终止了；而在 $\lambda_c$ 以上，穹顶完全由渐近 AdS 的毛黑洞组成。在穹顶底部，我们确定了标量场视界值最大的点，我们称之为临界点。在该点，该值位于视界有效势（具有朗道-金兹堡形式）所能拥有的最深的对称破缺点极小值处。与传统的朗道-金兹堡描述不同，这一解释基于视界处的标量场，而非边界序参量。在 $\lambda^*$ 以下，Lifshitz 不动点的常标量反而位于其渐近标度区域有效势的极小值处。
